thread:
taylor: FYI we published a small but important update to the Parental Leave policy this morning. Please review and acknowledge in the handbook portal by 2026-04-18. Link: https://handbook.redwood.example/policies/parental-leave

people-ops-bot: Published: Parental Leave update. Acknowledgement required for all full-time staff and extended contractors (>90 days). Reminder scheduled in 10 days.

lee: What changed exactly?

taylor: Main change: eligibility window extended to include employees who have been with the company 6 months (was 12). Also clarified payout cadence and documentation requirements. Short summary is in the top banner of the doc.

maria: Recruiting heads up: update the new hire packet so expectations are clear on leave accrual. I'll add a note to the onboarding checklist.

onboarding-bot: Auto: Onboarding checklist updated for new hires starting 2026-04-07 and later.

lee: Tracking question — how do we mark people on unpaid leave so they don't get auto-reminders?

taylor: Mark them in the tracking sheet with status 'on-leave-unpaid' and we'll suppress reminders for that status. If someone is expected back within 30 days, put 'on-leave-temp' so we follow up manually.

people-ops-bot: Digest: 3 teams acknowledged, 7 teams pending, 4 exceptions flagged. Reminder will run 2026-04-11.

taylor: Thanks all. If managers need a CSV export of pending folks, ping me and I'll run it.
